b1-independencia-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The World in 1808
b1-independencia-01.scenario: You are Meg. You visited a museum exhibition about 1808, and Carlos asks what you learned.
b1-independencia-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what had already happened in the world by 1808.
cues: Say what the United States had already done
Say what Haiti had already done
Say what happened to the Spanish king
b1-independencia-01.target: En 1808 los Estados Unidos ya habían declarado su independencia, y Haití también. El rey Fernando VII quedó cautivo en Francia.
b1-independencia-01.english: In 1808 the United States had already declared its independence, and Haiti too. King Ferdinand VII was held captive in France.
b1-independencia-01.canDo: I can say what had already happened in the world when Napoleon invaded Spain.

b1-independencia-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Grito de Dolores
b1-independencia-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You watched a documentary about Mexico, and Meg asks what happened in 1810.
b1-independencia-02.prompt: Tell Meg about Hidalgo and the Grito de Dolores.
cues: Say what he did on 16 September 1810
Say what happened to him in 1811
b1-independencia-02.target: Hidalgo era cura de Dolores cuando llamó a la población a levantarse. En 1811 los realistas lo capturaron y lo fusilaron.
b1-independencia-02.english: Hidalgo was the priest of Dolores when he called the people to rise. In 1811 the royalists captured him and shot him.
b1-independencia-02.canDo: I can say what Hidalgo did on 16 September 1810.

b1-independencia-03.title: Communicative Challenge: San Martín and the Andes
b1-independencia-03.scenario: You are Meg. You read a book about San Martín, and Carlos asks about the crossing of the Andes.
b1-independencia-03.prompt: Tell Carlos about San Martín in 1817.
cues: Say where he prepared his army
Say how his soldiers crossed the Andes
Say which battle the patriots won
b1-independencia-03.target: San Martín preparó un ejército en Mendoza. En 1817 cruzó los Andes subiendo por caminos de montaña, y los patriotas ganaron la batalla de Chacabuco.
b1-independencia-03.english: San Martín prepared an army in Mendoza. In 1817 he crossed the Andes going up mountain paths, and the patriots won the battle of Chacabuco.
b1-independencia-03.canDo: I can say how San Martín crossed the Andes and which battle the patriots won.

b1-independencia-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Debts and Loans
b1-independencia-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You had a class about the new republics, and Meg asks why they had money problems.
b1-independencia-04.prompt: Tell Meg what the governments had to do.
cues: Say what they had to ask for
b1-independencia-04.target: Los gobiernos necesitaban dinero y tuvieron que pedir préstamos. En la década de 1820 vendieron bonos en Londres.
b1-independencia-04.english: The governments needed money and had to ask for loans. In the 1820s they sold bonds in London.
b1-independencia-04.canDo: I can explain why governments had to ask for loans.

b1-independencia-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Independence for Whom?
b1-independencia-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read about independence in a book, and Carlos asks who benefited.
b1-independencia-05.prompt: Tell Carlos about slavery after independence.
cues: Say what the constitutions talked about
Say when it ended in Brazil
b1-independencia-05.target: Aunque las constituciones hablaban de igualdad, la esclavitud continuó. En Brasil terminó en 1888.
b1-independencia-05.english: Although the constitutions talked about equality, slavery continued. In Brazil it ended in 1888.
b1-independencia-05.canDo: I can say what the constitutions promised and when slavery ended in Brazil.

b1-independencia-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Independence Review
b1-independencia-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You visited a museum about independence with a friend, and Meg asks what you remember.
b1-independencia-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg one thing about 1808 and one about the new republics.
cues: Say what had already happened by 1808
Say what the new governments had to do
b1-independencia-consolidation.target: En 1808 los Estados Unidos ya habían declarado su independencia. Los nuevos gobiernos tuvieron que pedir préstamos.
b1-independencia-consolidation.english: In 1808 the United States had already declared its independence. The new governments had to ask for loans.
b1-independencia-consolidation.canDo: I can say what had already happened by 1808 and what the new governments had to do.
